lines: Truly, Śaṅkara — vow, giving, bathing, austerity: they dispel becoming’s heat.
But contemplating Your scripture as supreme nectar streams a bliss-stream in the mind.
sanskrit_cite: śaṅkara satyam idam vratadānasnānatapaḥ bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstra parāmṛtacintā cetasi nirvṛtidhārām syandati
